title: BT International and Netskope Expand Partnership to Deliver Integrated Security Service Edge Across Global Fabric
summary: Collaboration gives organizations optimized, high-performance connectivity between Netskope's SSE capabilities and BT's Global Fabric network,
body_markdown:
*Collaboration gives organizations optimized, high-performance connectivity between Netskope’s SSE capabilities and BT’s Global Fabric network, accelerating secure adoption of AI and cloud applications*


**SANTA CLARA, Calif. – October 14, 2026 –**[Netskope](http://www.netskope.com/) (NASDAQ: NTSK), a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era, has expanded its partnership with BT International. Organizations can now deploy optimized connectivity to Netskope’s Security Service Edge (SSE) services through BT International’s AI-ready Global Fabric network-as-a-service (NaaS) platform. This will help them roll out and scale AI agents, cloud applications, and autonomous digital workflows securely.


As organizations adopt AI at scale, network traffic patterns are changing fast. A growing number of users, AI agents, applications, and devices demand more bandwidth, lower latency, and access to multiple clouds from more locations, pushing traditional network and security architectures past their limits.


By using optimized Global Fabric connectivity into[Netskope One SSE](https://www.netskope.com/products/security-service-edge) , customers can leverage select predictable, high-performance routes for their traffic, improving applications’ responsiveness and user experience. It does this through Global Fabric’s cloud-centric architecture and strategically located points of presence around the world, which leverage direct IXP peering to connect into the[Netskope One platform](https://www.netskope.com/netskope-one) .


The partnership builds on Netskope’s position as a leading SSE provider, including its recent recognition for the[fifth year in a row as a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Security Service Edge](https://www.netskope.com/press-releases/netskope-named-a-leader-in-the-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-security-service-edge-for-5th-year-in-a-row) . It is one of a select group of SSE integrations now available through Global Fabric, reflecting Netskope’s role as a strategic security partner as BT International expands the platform to help customers accelerate cloud transformation and AI adoption while meeting evolving security and sovereignty requirements.


“Netskope is a strategic partner in helping us deliver the AI-ready digital foundations our customers need,” said Matt Swinden, managing director, strategy & product, BT International. “Bringing together the Netskope SSE platform with Global Fabric gives customers a more predictable, higher-performing path between their users, agents, and the security services protecting them, while giving them the flexibility to choose the level of protection that fits their business.”


**Key benefits for customers include:**


- Optimized, low-latency routing between users, AI agents, with the help of IXP peering between the Netskope One platform and BT’s Global Fabric.
- Consistent security policy enforcement and performance for users anywhere in the world.
- Faster, safer scaling of agentic AI and cloud application adoption with real-time, context-based protection.
- A single BT-managed SASE experience combining Netskope’s SSE with Global Fabric connectivity, improving resilience and path diversity.


“AI is rapidly changing what organizations need from their security architecture,” said Parag Thakore, Chief Product Officer, SASE, Netskope. “Agents, applications, and users all need fast, reliable, real-time access to data and cloud services, and that means security has to be built into the network path, not bolted on as an afterthought. By bringing closer the Netskope One platform and BT International’s Global Fabric, we’re giving multinational customers an optimized, high-performance routing capability to the protection they need, without the latency and complexity of traditional architectures.”


**About Netskope**


Netskope (NASDAQ: NTSK), a leader in modern security and networking for the cloud and AI era, addresses the needs of both security and networking teams by providing optimized access and real-time, context-based security for the AI ecosystem inclusive of agents, applications, tools, LLMs, people, devices, and data. Thousands of customers, including more than 30% of the Fortune 100, trust the Netskope One platform, its Zero Trust Engine, and its powerful NewEdge network to reduce risk and gain full visibility and control over cloud, AI, SaaS, web, and private applications — providing security and accelerating performance without trade-offs.
